atoms.sound: Work and travel means going to another country to work for a while.

instruction.text: Ergänze die Sätze über Work and Travel.
instruction.sound: Ergänze die Sätze über <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2_2025'>Work and Travel</voice>

atoms.a: Es kann schwierig sein, im Ausland eine Arbeit zu finden.
atoms.b: It can be difficult to find a ((++job friend)) abroad.

atoms.a: Du hast möglicherweise nicht so viel Zeit zum Reisen, wenn du viel arbeiten musst.
atoms.b: You might not have as much time to ((++travel jump)) around if you have to ((++work study)) a lot.

atoms.a: Normalerweise kann man während des Work-and-Travel-Aufenthalts nicht länger als 1-2 Jahre in einem Land bleiben.
atoms.b: Usually you can't stay longer than 1-2 ((++years months)) in one ((++country continent)) while doing your work and travel.

atoms.a: Möglicherweise verdient man nicht genug Geld für alle Reisekosten.
atoms.b: You might not earn enough ((++money mails)) for all of your ((++travel_expenses shopping)).

atoms.a: Während der Arbeit kann man viele neue Orte sehen.
atoms.b: You can see many new ((++places faces)) while working.
You can learn about different ((++cultures cars)).

instruction.text: Ordne die Vor- und Nachteile von Work and Travel passend zu.
instruction.sound: Ordne die Vor- und Nachteile von <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2_2025'>Work and Travel</voice>  passend zu.

atoms.a: You might miss your friends and family in your home country.
You might face language problems if you don't speak the local language.
It might be tough to get used to a new culture.
You can meet new people and make friends in different countries.
You can get more independent since you take care of yourself.
You can try out different jobs and gain professional experiences.
